shared_style: Square 1254px or larger photorealistic L Beauty salon detail, warm cream/sage palette, soft natural light, no text/logo/collage. Equipment photos: no people, skin or body parts. Nail photos: hands only.

subjects.subject: Macro photograph of a Black woman's short natural oval nails with a thin clear acrylic overlay in sheer blush pink, visible natural free edge, NO extensions, no tips, no nail art. Relaxed hand on sage linen, realistic fingers, freshly moisturised hands.
Full-arm waxing equipment: broad flat wooden spatulas fanned beside a roll of white nonwoven waxing strips and a closed amber wax tin on a sage salon trolley. Top down still life.
Half-arm waxing equipment: compact professional roll-on wax cartridge heater with translucent honey cartridge, cotton waxing strips and two spatulas on cream stone. Side-lit macro photograph.
Full-leg waxing equipment: large double professional wax warmer filled with amber wax, broad waxing strips neatly stacked, sage towel. Wide overhead detail.
Half-leg waxing supplies: amber hard-wax beads spilling gently from a clear jar into a small cream ceramic bowl, broad spatula beside folded waxing strips. Low angle close-up.
Back-waxing preparation equipment: wide disposable waxing strips, extra-wide wooden applicators and a stainless steel wax bowl with glossy amber wax, on a sage towel. No treatment recipient.
Underarm waxing preparation supplies: petite white wax warmer with green hard wax, short rounded wooden spatulas and cotton pads, clean compact arrangement on cream counter.
Bikini waxing preparation equipment: purple hard-wax beads in a glass jar, small violet wax warmer bowl, hygienic sealed applicators on sage linen. No people.
Professional body waxing equipment: large flat wooden applicators laid diagonally across a stainless salon tray, peach hard-wax pearls in a bowl and folded white towel. Macro still life.

Full-face waxing equipment setup: professional small white wax warmer with pale pink hard wax, fine facial applicators neatly arranged radially, cotton pads, clean treatment tray. Side angle.
Short natural rounded nails, sheer pink gel manicure with delicate thin white French tips, no acrylic extensions; Black woman's hand on cream linen and sage accent.
